description: This file defines the SparkTransportConf object which provides utility methods to create TransportConf instances from SparkConf configurations, specifically for network transport settings in Apache Spark.

classes.name: SparkTransportConf
classes.description: Object providing utility to create TransportConf from SparkConf with environment details.

methods.name: fromSparkConf
methods.description: Creates a TransportConf instance from a SparkConf, with options for module name, core restrictions, role, and SSL options.
